summary: The HSPnetPager is a .NET web control for managing pagination on web pages. It provides functionality to render a paging control, manage control state, handle postback events, and manage pagination logic such as starting and ending page indices, and previous/next page navigation.
purpose: The primary purpose of HSPnetPager is to facilitate paginated navigation of large datasets in web applications, allowing users to move between pages of data efficiently.

fields.name: CurrentIndex
fields.description: The current page index being displayed.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description: The number of items to display per page.

fields.name: PageCount
fields.description: Total number of pages calculated based on ItemCount and PageSize.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: The starting row index for the current page.

workflows.name: RenderPaginationControl
steps: Verify rendering in the server form.
Define table attributes for cellspacing, cellpadding, etc.
Calculate pager start and end indices.
Create previous and next buttons and ellipses.

business_rules: If the CurrentIndex exceeds the PageCount, set CurrentIndex to PageCount.
Page size can be toggled between a default and a maximum size to simulate 'Show All' functionality.
validations: Ensure PageSize and ItemCount are set before rendering.
Calculate PageCount as the ceiling of ItemCount divided by PageSize.
calculations: Calculate the starting and ending page index for pagination navigation.
Convert page index to page number and vice versa.
conditions: Show pagination controls only if PageCount > 1.
Switch between display of 'Show All' and 'Show Page Size' based on total items.
system_behavior: Registers control state to maintain pagination indices across postbacks.
Handles postback events to manage page changes.
exceptions: Handle conditions where no pagination is required due to ItemCount being less than PageSize.
